label: The ripple counter
subgoals: Clock each stage from the previous stage's output
Chain one clock-to-q per toggling bit in the worst case
Multiply the bit count by clock-to-q

label: Reading a ripple counter safely
subgoals: Add the full ripple settle time to the sampler's setup time
Invert the period to get the frequency
Compare with a synchronous counter's clock-to-q plus incrementer plus setup

label: Modulus and state count
subgoals: Compute the flip-flop count as the ceiling of log base two of N
Subtract N from two to that count for the unused codes
Declare divided outputs as generated clocks
